entry: The opening range is the first 15 minutes (a 30-minute version was also tested).
The signal is the first 5-minute close beyond the range. Enter at the next bar's open.
exit: Otherwise exit at 15:55. A variant exits at a 2R target.
stop_loss: Stop at the other side of the opening range.
filters: SPY, QQQ and IWM on 5-minute bars, regular hours only, January 2020 to September 2026.
One trade per fund per day. No overnight holds, no leverage.
